title: Adomate
claim: Product Hunt: Adomate — Turn data into winning ads. At scale.
why_good: Adomate leverages AI to automate ad creation, reducing the barrier for small businesses to compete with larger firms.
value: Businesses pay for a subscription or per-ad fee to access the platform's AI-driven ad generation capabilities.
risk: The market is saturated with ad tools, and larger incumbents could easily replicate its features or integrate them into existing platforms.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
